_metadata.context: All wage gap figures refer to Urban Regular/Salaried Employment unless noted. This is the most comparable category for campus-placement IT salaries.

Caste.gap_direction: SC/ST earn 24.7% less than General category
Caste.note: Urban regular/salaried employment. Gap largely explained by endowment differences; legal mandates on equal pay reduce pure discrimination in formal regular employment.

Religion.note: Urban regular/salaried employment. Non-Muslims earn ~49% more than Muslims. Most of this gap is explained by lower educational endowments, not pure discrimination.

Gender.gap_direction: Females earn ~20-60% less than Males (urban salaried); 67% of gap is discrimination
Gender.note: Urban regular/salaried employment. Discrimination component for younger women is higher; decreases to 54% for women aged 25+ as bargaining power improves with experience. Derived gap_pct = (21000-15578)/21000 ≈ 25.8%
